summary.text: Louise Andrus is a Republican state representative from Merrimack 5 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career has been in administrative work, including at Proctor Academy.

paragraphs.text: Louise Andrus grew up in Wilmot, New Hampshire, lives in Salisbury, and graduated from Andover High School.

Her career experience includes working as an administrative assistant for the director of admissions at Proctor Academy in Andover and in various administrative positions in the private and public sectors.
Ballotpedia lists Andrus's tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2020.
She served on the House Judiciary Committee in 2023-2024 and the House Education Committee in 2021-2022.
